profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Priceline | Backend & Distributed Systems | Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Kubernetes | GCP, AWS
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience building scalable backend systems using Java and Spring, with production experience across GCP and AWS.

Currently at Priceline, designing and maintaining Spring-based services that support large-scale, customer-facing applications, with a focus on reliability, performance, and clean architecture.

Previously at Vanguard, contributing to Spring backend systems on AWS, and earlier at PEF Services, building automation solutions to improve engineering efficiency.

Core skills:
• Java, Spring (Boot, MVC), REST APIs, Microservices
• GCP, AWS
• React, Node.js, Angular (working knowledge)
• System design, scalability, performance, CI/CD

Interested in backend, platform, and senior software engineering opportunities.

positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with the automation team to design and develop automated test suites for the software services using Java, Groovy, and Selenium.
• Structured development and testing improvements to positively impact usability, function and performance.
• Manufactured updates to the  in-house automation framework, environment and efficiencies in automation development.

projects.title: Exam Web Application, JavaScript, PHP, Python, HTML, CSS, MySQL
projects.description: •A Full-stack web application where instructors can create and post Python exams for students to take. Instructors can see auto graded exams that students completed and release the grade of exams to students.

projects.title: 15 Piece Tile Sorter, C
projects.description: •Using A* sorting and Heuristics to solve a generated 15 Tile Numeric Puzzle in ascending order.
